title: Improved existence time for a Boussinesq system
summary: We consider a strongly dispersive Boussinesq-type system arising as a model for the propagation of weakly nonlinear water waves. The system is characterized by a nonlinearity parameter $0 0$. Our results show quantitatively how the lifespan depends on the balance between nonlinearity and dispersion in the regimes $ε\lesssim μ$ and $μ\llε$. They also make explicit how the existence time deteriorates as $h_0\to0$, that is, as the wave approaches cavitation. Our proofs combine dispersive and Strichartz estimates with energy estimates.
